cases.note: Project package round trip through storage
Unrecognised top-level keys survive a round trip verbatim
Sections outside the declared reads are reported, not dropped
A package in storage changes nothing until the user applies it
A throwing localStorage degrades to no package, with the calculation unchanged
A patch outside the declared write paths is refused and nothing is written
A malformed flag is refused; a well-formed one passes
The review decisions register survives this tool's save and cannot be patched by it

manifest.note: Manifest v2, tools.petrov.re namespace, project-delivery category; benchmark run_at equals the artifact run_at and the declared case counts equal the artifact totals.

localisation.note: 204 tool label objects carry all seven languages with no empty value and no Cyrillic text in an en slot; the report body was rebuilt in en, uk, de, nl, fr, es and pl and renders tool-owned vocabulary in the selected language.

mobile_desktop.note: Rendered at 1440x900 and 390x844: document scrollWidth equals clientWidth at both widths, no root horizontal overflow.

permalink_round_trip.note: State encoded and decoded through the framework codec and re-applied to a fresh page.

presets.note: Six examples load through the public DiagramUI example API; each produced a verdict, four tiles and a findings table with no console error.

learn_mode.note: Intro, five topics and a five-step tour are declared through DiagramUI and render.

stale_recompute.note: Live-compute tool; every state change recomputes the assessment before the results panel repaints.

report_all_languages.note: Diagram.report({mode:html}) built in all seven languages: 9 sections and one figure in each.

report_pagination.note: Report uses framework pagination; the tool declares no print layout of its own.

report_figure.note: The Definition Map is supplied through ctx.figure at 1520x860 with a localized caption and the stage text alternative, so the printed figure no longer follows the reader window width.

invalid_tokens.note: Report text and the CSV record export carry zero undefined, NaN, [object Object] and unfilled brace placeholders.

report_repetition.note: Every example state prints no repeated sentence. On the empty default state, where 23 findings share three method-basis citations, 4 groups repeat for 9 redundant occurrences; each is a labelled Basis or Actual field of a check card rather than prose.

benchmark_regeneration_parity.note: window.__dgcBenchmark() deep-equals the shipped artifact after JSON serialization normalization.

benchmark_coverage.note: The 7 cases assert 9 distinct rule identifiers; a driven sweep over the six examples and every context selector reaches 47. Coverage of the rule engine is 9 of 47, which is why the tool stays at prototype.

console.note: Zero page errors and zero console errors over boot, six example loads, seven report builds and both viewports.
